title: <session-dir>/session.json (Studio session metadata)
notes: The engine NEVER reads this file; cli-main.jsonl is the conversation history.
Only writer: POST /api/sessions when model and/or prompt is non-empty (both empty -> the file is not created).
Written with a plain std::fs::write (NOT atomic, no fsync).
Copied by branch; follows a rename because the whole directory moves.
POST /api/config does NOT write it back: the session-level model is decided at creation time.

model.description: model id override; invalid value -> 400 invalid session model: {e} on activate

prompt.description: bound prompt id (section_overrides of that prompt are applied last)
